title.zh: 安装一个 Skill，为什么不该等于“信任整个包”？
title.en: Why Should Installing a Skill Not Mean Trusting the Whole Package?

dek.zh: 拆开 instruction、code、assets、tools 的 trust domain，设计 permission manifest、依赖解析、sandbox、版本 pinning 与组合冲突处理。
dek.en: Separate instruction, code, assets, and tools into distinct trust domains, then design permission manifests, dependency resolution, sandboxes, version pinning, and composition conflict handling.

html.zh:
skill 或 plugin 往往被描述为“给 Agent 增加一种能力”，但一个包可能同时包含 instruction、可执行代码、模板/assets、外部文档、多个 tools、MCP server 配置和依赖。它们的风险完全不同：instruction 可以改变模型决策，code 可以读写机器状态，data 可以注入恶意内容，tool 可以触发外部副作用。把“安装”解释为对整包的永久信任，会把这些边界压成一个模糊开关。

可靠 extension host 应将 package 当成待解析的 capability graph。Manifest 声明组件、entrypoints、依赖、所需权限、网络目的地、文件范围、secrets、tool exposure 与 lifecycle hooks；host 验证来源与完整性，解析 transitive permissions，在 sandbox 中加载代码，并按任务启用最小组件。高风险使用仍需要运行时 authorization/consent，不能靠安装时一次确认永久放行。

核心判断：package 是分发单位，不是 trust domain。Trust 必须分别绑定 artifact identity、component type、effective permission、execution environment、task purpose 与时间；composition 后的权限和指令冲突要重新计算，而不是简单取并集。
html.en:
A skill or plugin is often described as “adding one capability,” but a package may contain instructions, executable code, templates and assets, external documents, several tools, MCP server configuration, and dependencies. Their risks differ. Instructions shape model decisions, code reads or mutates machine state, data can carry hostile content, and tools trigger external effects. Treating installation as permanent trust in the whole bundle collapses these boundaries into one vague switch.

A reliable extension host treats a package as a capability graph to resolve. A manifest declares components, entry points, dependencies, required permissions, network destinations, filesystem scopes, secrets, tool exposure, and lifecycle hooks. The host verifies origin and integrity, resolves transitive permissions, loads code inside sandboxes, and enables the minimum components for the task. High-risk use still requires runtime authorization or consent; one install-time click cannot approve every future effect.

Core judgment: a package is a distribution unit, not a trust domain. Trust binds separately to artifact identity, component type, effective permission, execution environment, task purpose, and time. Composition recalculates permissions and instruction conflicts instead of taking a blind union.

title.zh: 承接 Tool/MCP：catalog 只是 extension 的一个输出
title.en: A tool catalog is only one output of an extension

html.zh:
1/4 将 tool 定义为 action contract；2/4 将 MCP catalog 定义为未经信任的 capability claims。skill/plugin 位于更上层：它可能提供 prompt-level procedure、调用顺序、scripts、schemas、server binaries 和 UI assets，最终生成或筛选 tool catalog。Host 不能因为 tools 已经过 schema validation，就忽略生成这些 tools 的 code 与 instructions。

例如“发布助手”skill 可能指导模型先运行测试、生成 changelog、调用 deployment tool；plugin 同时打包 test script、GitHub MCP server 和 deployment credentials connector。instruction 本身不应读取 credential；script 不应自动拥有 deployment tool；MCP server 不应因同包安装而跳过 catalog policy。组件间通信应通过显式、typed interface，而不是共享全部环境和 filesystem。

组合还会改变语义。两个各自安全的 skills 若都定义“发布完成”的判断，可能一个以上传 artifact 为终态，另一个要求 production health。Host 需要 precedence、namespace 和 conflict policy；不能按加载顺序让最后一段 instruction 获胜。
html.en:
Part 1 defined tools as action contracts. Part 2 treated MCP catalogs as untrusted capability claims. Skills and plugins sit above both. They may supply prompt-level procedures, invocation order, scripts, schemas, server binaries, and UI assets, eventually generating or filtering a tool catalog. A host cannot ignore code and instructions that produced the catalog merely because tool schemas validate.

A release-assistant skill might tell the model to run tests, generate a changelog, and call a deployment tool. Its plugin may package a test script, a GitHub MCP server, and a deployment-credential connector. The instruction should not read credentials. The script should not automatically receive the deployment tool. The server should not bypass catalog policy because it arrived in the same installation. Components communicate through explicit typed interfaces rather than sharing every environment variable and filesystem path.

Composition changes semantics too. Two individually safe skills may disagree about “release complete”: one ends after artifact upload, another requires production health. The host needs precedence, namespaces, and conflict policy. It cannot let load order make the last instruction win.

title.zh: 机制：把 extension 编译成最小权限 capability graph
title.en: Mechanism: compile an extension into a least-privilege capability graph

html.zh:
1. Manifest 描述组件而非一句“需要完全访问”

manifest 列 packageId/version、publisher、components、entrypoints、content digests、dependencies、compatible host/protocol、requested permissions 与 lifecycle hooks。权限是结构化资源范围：filesystem read/write roots、network origins/methods、secret names、process spawn、clipboard、browser domain、tool call classes；不接受模糊 “internet” 或 “all files”。

2. 验证 artifact identity 与 provenance

下载后在执行前验证 digest/signature、publisher identity、transparency/provenance statement 和 expected source。签名证明某 identity 发布了 bytes，不证明 bytes 安全。Host 仍做 malware/static policy scan、archive path traversal、symlink、executable bit、unexpected binary 和 size/decompression limits。

3. 解析 dependency graph

resolver 固定 direct 与 transitive versions/digests，检测 cycle、conflict、yanked/revoked package 和 platform variant。effective permissions 是整个依赖闭包的需求，但不是简单 union 后自动批准：新增 transitive network/secret permission 会触发重新 consent 或拒绝。lockfile/snapshot 进入 execution trace，避免第二天解析到不同代码。

4. 分离 instruction、data 与 code

instruction component 可影响 model policy flow，但被限定在 host 指定层级和 task namespace，不能伪装 system/developer instruction。external docs/assets 永远标 data，内容中的命令不提升 authority。code component 在单独 sandbox 执行，以 typed stdin/stdout 或 RPC 通信，不共享模型完整 context、credentials 和 host process memory。

5. 编译 effective permission graph

Host 将 manifest request 与 admin policy、user consent、workspace trust、task purpose、platform capabilities 求交集。每个 component 获得独立 capability tokens，例如 code 可读取 checkout 但不能调用 deployment tool；instruction 可建议调用，但真正 dispatch 仍过 tool policy。拒绝某权限时，extension 应明确 degraded mode，而非静默改用别的通道。

6. Sandbox 与 broker

code sandbox 默认无网络、无 secrets、只读 package 和临时 working dir。filesystem/network/process/credential 通过 broker 请求，broker 验证 capability token、resource、purpose、quota 与 audit context。sandbox 边界取决于风险：language VM、OS process/container、remote worker 都有不同 escape surface；“运行在子进程”不等于安全 sandbox。

7. Instruction composition 与冲突

Host 以显式 precedence 合并：platform policy > workspace policy > user-enabled workflow > extension guidance > retrieved data。Extensions 只能在声明 namespace 定义 procedure/output template。两个同层 rules 冲突时，不按 install/load order 决定，而是 fail closed、请求用户选择，或用 manifest 声明的 exclusive/provides/replaces relation 解析。

8. Tool 与 hook activation

安装只验证并保存 package；启用决定哪些 components 进入 workspace；每次 task 再选择 instructions/tools；高风险 tool call 或 lifecycle hook 仍需运行时 gate。pre/post hooks 不能绕过主 command policy，也不能在用户取消后继续运行。hook ordering、timeout、failure mode 与 compensation 必须显式。

9. Version upgrade 与 migration

升级比较 content digest、manifest、dependency graph、effective permissions、instruction diff、tool schema 与 migration code。permission expansion 要重新 consent；breaking instruction/tool changes 创建新 major version。运行中 workflow pin 旧 snapshot，新 tasks 才用新版，除非显式 migration。rollback 保留 compatible state schema，不能只把 binary 降级。

10. Uninstall 与撤销

先阻断新 activation，撤销 capability tokens/secrets/credentials，取消未 dispatch work，再按 contract 处理 in-flight effects。删除 package code、cache、index 和 extension-owned durable state，但保留最小审计/tombstone；shared artifacts 由 ownership policy 决定。Uninstall 不是删除用户业务数据，也不是让已发生副作用倒流。

11. Composition trace 与 eval

每次 model turn 记录启用 packages/versions、effective instruction digest、permission snapshot、available tools 与 sandbox image。eval 包含 malicious instruction asset、dependency permission expansion、namespace collision、hook timeout、sandbox escape attempt 与 rollback replay。最终 task success 之外，要测 forbidden capability use=0、consent accuracy 和 provenance completeness。
html.en:
1. A manifest describes components, not “full access”

The manifest lists package ID and version, publisher, components, entry points, content digests, dependencies, compatible hosts and protocols, requested permissions, and lifecycle hooks. Permissions name structured resource scopes: filesystem read and write roots, network origins and methods, secret names, process spawn, clipboard, browser domains, and tool-call classes. Vague requests such as “internet” or “all files” are rejected.

2. Verify artifact identity and provenance

Before execution, verify digest or signature, publisher identity, provenance or transparency statement, and expected source. A signature proves that an identity published particular bytes; it does not prove safety. The host still scans malware and static policy, archive path traversal, symlinks, executable bits, unexpected binaries, package size, and decompression limits.

3. Resolve the dependency graph

The resolver pins direct and transitive versions and digests and detects cycles, conflicts, yanked or revoked packages, and platform variants. Effective permissions reflect the full dependency closure, but the host cannot blindly union and approve them. A new transitive network or secret permission triggers fresh consent or rejection. A lockfile or snapshot enters the execution trace so tomorrow cannot resolve to different code.

4. Separate instructions, data, and code

An instruction component may shape model workflow but remains at a host-assigned precedence and task namespace; it cannot impersonate platform instructions. External documents and assets remain data, so commands inside them gain no authority. A code component runs in a separate sandbox and communicates through typed stdin and stdout or RPC. It does not share full model context, credentials, or host-process memory.

5. Compile an effective permission graph

The host intersects manifest requests with administrator policy, user consent, workspace trust, task purpose, and platform capability. Every component receives separate capability tokens. Code may read a checkout without calling deployment tools. An instruction may recommend a call, but actual dispatch still passes tool policy. When a permission is denied, the extension reports an explicit degraded mode instead of silently using another channel.

6. Sandbox through a broker

Code sandboxes default to no network and no secrets, with read-only package files and a temporary working directory. Filesystem, network, process, and credential access go through a broker that validates the capability token, resource, purpose, quota, and audit context. The sandbox strength matches risk: language VM, OS process or container, and remote worker have different escape surfaces. “Child process” alone is not a security boundary.

7. Compose instructions and resolve conflicts

The host applies explicit precedence: platform policy, workspace policy, user-enabled workflow, extension guidance, then retrieved data. Extensions define procedures and output templates only inside declared namespaces. Conflicting peer rules do not resolve by installation or load order. The host fails closed, requests a user choice, or applies manifest relationships such as exclusive, provides, and replaces.

8. Activate tools and hooks separately

Installation verifies and stores a package. Enablement selects components for a workspace. Each task selects relevant instructions and tools. A high-risk tool call or lifecycle hook still passes a runtime gate. Pre- and post-hooks cannot bypass the main command policy or continue after cancellation. Ordering, timeout, failure mode, and compensation are explicit.

9. Upgrade versions and state deliberately

An upgrade compares content digest, manifest, dependency graph, effective permissions, instruction diff, tool schemas, and migration code. Permission expansion requires renewed consent. Breaking instruction or tool changes create a new major version. Running workflows pin old snapshots; new tasks use the new version unless explicitly migrated. Rollback preserves a compatible state schema rather than merely downgrading binaries.

10. Uninstall and revoke

First block new activation, revoke capability tokens, secrets, and credentials, and cancel work not yet dispatched. In-flight effects follow their business contracts. Remove package code, caches, indexes, and extension-owned durable state while retaining minimal audit or tombstones. Shared artifacts follow ownership policy. Uninstalling does not delete user business data or reverse completed effects.

11. Trace and evaluate composition

Every model turn records enabled package versions, effective instruction digest, permission snapshot, available tools, and sandbox image. Evaluations include hostile instruction assets, transitive permission expansion, namespace collision, hook timeout, sandbox escape attempt, and rollback replay. Beyond task success, measure zero forbidden capability use, consent accuracy, and provenance completeness.

title.zh: 必要数学：transitive 权限与组合爆炸
title.en: Essential mathematics: transitive permission and composition growth

html.zh:
Effective permissions

若 package 依赖闭包为 D，每个 component 请求权限集合 Pᵢ，管理员/用户/任务允许集合分别为 A、U、T，则实际可授予 P_eff=(⋃ᵢ∈D Pᵢ)∩A∩U∩T。但执行仍按 component 切片 P_eff,c，而不是把全局并集发给所有组件。公式说明 dependency 新增权限必须重新求值。

组合冲突规模

启用 N 个 extensions，潜在 pairwise rule/tool collision 为 N(N−1)/2。从 10 增至 50，pair 从 45 到 1,225。namespace 减少名称冲突，但 semantic conflict 仍需 provides/replaces/exclusive 和 task-level eval。

Risk budget

可定义 extension 风险 R=Σ pᵢ·impactᵢ·exposureᵢ，覆盖 network、secrets、write、hooks 等 capabilities。它不是精确概率，而是比较设计：缩小 exposure（资源范围、时长、调用次数）通常比只降低“模型误用概率”更可控。
html.en:
Effective permissions

Let dependency closure be D, each component request permission set Pᵢ, and administrator, user, and task allow sets be A, U, and T. The maximum grant is P_eff=(⋃ᵢ∈D Pᵢ)∩A∩U∩T. Execution still receives a per-component slice P_eff,c rather than the global union. A dependency that adds permission changes the calculation and therefore requires review.

Composition growth

With N enabled extensions, potential pairwise rule or tool collisions number N(N−1)/2. Increasing from ten to fifty extensions grows pairs from forty-five to 1,225. Namespaces reduce name collisions, but semantic conflict still needs provides, replaces, exclusive relationships, and task-level evaluation.

Risk budget

An extension risk score may be modeled as R=Σ pᵢ·impactᵢ·exposureᵢ across network, secrets, writes, and hooks. This is not a precise probability. It supports design comparison: reducing exposure through resource scope, duration, and call count is usually more controllable than merely hoping to reduce model misuse probability.

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
能力：extension 可复用完整 procedure、tools、code 和 templates，而不把所有复杂度放进 system prompt。按组件启用允许同一包在不同 workspace 进入不同 degraded mode。

可靠性：lockfile、snapshot、instruction digest、sandbox image 与 state schema 使 execution 可 replay。升级/rollback 不再是“装最新版本”，而是 contract migration。

安全：签名、manifest、sandbox、broker、runtime authorization 分层；任何一层都不把来源可信等同于行为安全。transitive dependency 和 hook 不获得隐式权限。

运营：应监控 install verification、dependency resolution、permission expansion、sandbox denial/escape、hook latency/failure、instruction conflict、tool selection 和 uninstall coverage。extension task success 不能掩盖 forbidden capability attempts。
html.en:
Capability: extensions package reusable procedures, tools, code, and templates without placing every detail in the system prompt. Per-component enablement lets one package run in different degraded modes across workspaces.

Reliability: lockfiles, snapshots, instruction digests, sandbox images, and state schemas make execution replayable. Upgrade and rollback become contract migrations rather than “install latest.”

Security: signatures, manifests, sandboxes, brokers, and runtime authorization form layers. No layer equates trusted origin with safe behavior. Transitive dependencies and hooks receive no implicit permission.

Operations: monitor installation verification, dependency resolution, permission expansion, sandbox denial and escape, hook latency and failure, instruction conflict, tool selection, and uninstall coverage. Extension task success cannot average away forbidden capability attempts.

html.zh:
• 安装即全信任：instruction/code/tool 共用全部权限；按 component capability 拆分。
  • 签名即安全：签名只绑定 publisher/bytes；仍需 policy scan、sandbox 与 runtime authorization。
  • 依赖权限隐藏：小更新引入 secret/network dependency；lockfile diff 与 permission re-consent。
  • load-order 冲突：最后加载 instruction 覆盖前者；显式 precedence/namespace/exclusive。
  • 共享进程 sandbox：内存/env/handles 泄漏；按风险使用 OS/container/remote isolation 与 broker。
  • hook 绕过：post-hook 在取消后继续或调用未授权 tool；hook 同样绑定 lifecycle、deadline、policy。
  • 升级漂移：running workflow 自动换新版；snapshot pin 和 explicit migration。
  • 卸载即擦除：误删用户数据或遗留 credentials/cache；ownership、revocation、tombstone 分阶段。
html.en:
• Install means full trust: instruction, code, and tools share all permissions. Split component capabilities.
  • Signature means safe: signatures bind publisher and bytes only. Still scan policy, sandbox code, and authorize at runtime.
  • Hidden dependency permission: a minor update adds secret or network access. Diff lockfiles and renew consent.
  • Load-order conflict: the last instruction silently wins. Use explicit precedence, namespaces, and exclusivity.
  • Shared-process sandbox: memory, environment, and handles leak. Use OS, container, or remote isolation plus brokers according to risk.
  • Hook bypass: a post-hook continues after cancellation or calls an unauthorized tool. Hooks bind to lifecycle, deadline, and policy.
  • Upgrade drift: running workflows automatically use a new version. Pin snapshots and migrate explicitly.
  • Uninstall means erasure: user data is deleted or credentials and caches remain. Apply ownership, revocation, and tombstones in stages.

html.zh:
• package 是分发单位，不是 trust domain；instruction、data、code、tools 分开授权与隔离。
  • manifest 声明组件/依赖/权限；host 计算 dependency closure 的 effective permissions，并按 component 切片。
  • 安装、workspace 启用、task selection、高风险 dispatch 是不同授权时刻。
  • sandbox 默认 deny，通过 capability broker 访问 filesystem/network/process/secrets。
  • composition 需要 namespace、precedence、provides/replaces/exclusive、snapshot pin 与 conflict eval。
html.en:
• A package is a distribution unit, not a trust domain. Authorize and isolate instructions, data, code, and tools separately.
  • A manifest declares components, dependencies, and permissions. The host computes dependency-closure permissions and slices them per component.
  • Installation, workspace enablement, task selection, and high-risk dispatch are separate authorization moments.
  • Sandboxes default-deny; a capability broker mediates filesystem, network, process, and secrets.
  • Composition needs namespaces, precedence, provides or replaces or exclusive relationships, snapshot pinning, and conflict evaluation.

html.zh:
• SLSA v1.1 — software artifact provenance 与 build integrity 规范。
  • SPDX 3.0.1 — SBOM、软件组件与关系的数据规范。
  • OCI Image Specification — content-addressed manifests/layers/config 的规范。
  • OCI Runtime Specification — container runtime/config/isolation 的规范边界。
  • NIST SSDF SP 800-218 — secure software development 与供应链实践。
  • RFC 9334 RATS Architecture — attestation evidence、endorsements 与 appraisal 的架构术语。

component trust split、effective permission graph、instruction precedence 与 extension lifecycle 是本文基于供应链和 sandbox 原则的编辑性综合。
html.en:
• SLSA v1.1 — specifications for software-artifact provenance and build integrity.
  • SPDX 3.0.1 — a data specification for software bills of materials, components, and relationships.
  • OCI Image Specification — content-addressed manifests, layers, and configuration.
  • OCI Runtime Specification — specification boundaries for container runtime, configuration, and isolation.
  • NIST SSDF SP 800-218 — secure software development and supply-chain practices.
  • RFC 9334 RATS Architecture — architecture terminology for attestation evidence, endorsements, and appraisal.

The component trust split, effective permission graph, instruction precedence, and extension lifecycle are editorial synthesis from supply-chain and sandbox principles.

title.en: What is established and where we continue

html.zh:
今天已建立：extension package 被解析为 instruction/data/code/tools 的 capability graph；依赖闭包、manifest、provenance 与 policy 生成按 component 切片的 effective permissions。sandbox/broker 隔离 code，显式 precedence/namespace 处理 instruction composition，snapshot pin 支撑 upgrade/rollback。

尚未讲完：完整 Tools & Extensibility 系统如何做端到端安全与质量评测？怎样验证 tool selection、schema、discovery、permission、sandbox、hook、升级、撤销和供应链不在组合后失效？

下一篇：Tools 与 Extensibility 4/4 完成本系列：extension eval、prompt injection/SSRF/secret exfiltration defenses、contract testing、online rollout 与生产检查表。
html.en:
Established today: an extension package resolves into a capability graph across instructions, data, code, and tools. Dependency closure, manifest, provenance, and policy generate per-component effective permissions. Sandboxes and brokers isolate code; explicit precedence and namespaces compose instructions; snapshot pinning supports upgrade and rollback.

Still unresolved: how does the complete Tools and Extensibility system receive end-to-end safety and quality evaluation? How do we verify that selection, schema, discovery, permissions, sandboxing, hooks, upgrades, revocation, and supply chain do not fail after composition?

Next: Tools and Extensibility 4/4 completes the series with extension evaluation, defenses against prompt injection, SSRF, and secret exfiltration, contract testing, online rollout, and a production checklist.

zh: package 是分发单位，不是 trust domain
instruction/data/code/tools 按 component 分别授权与隔离
依赖闭包与 policy 生成按 component 切片的 effective permission graph
snapshot pin、显式 precedence 与 lifecycle 支撑安全 composition/upgrade/uninstall
en: A package is a distribution unit, not a trust domain
Instructions, data, code, and tools are authorized and isolated per component
Dependency closure and policy produce a per-component effective permission graph
Snapshot pinning, explicit precedence, and lifecycle rules support safe composition, upgrade, and uninstall
